tests.name: strict JSON rejects duplicate/escaped duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers and depth abuse
worker/planner calls stream through one authenticated route with safe attribution
missing, wrong, expired and lease-expired tokens never reach the router
noncanonical paths, other protocols, management and methods are denied
route identity, model, strict-schema, media, account and header overrides are denied
request bytes, output tokens, duplicate keys and unsupported fields reject before forwarding
complete tools are withheld until valid terminal/EOF and support tool-result continuation
each UTF-8/SSE split boundary preserves text/tools and refuses trailing data or false DONE
partial tool and error streams never emit executable tools or raw errors
response byte limits abort without forwarding an oversized chunk
request count and concurrency reservations bound each attempt with no router retries
heartbeats do not extend first-output or semantic-idle deadlines
total deadline and attempt-wide expiry terminate active transport
revocation during durable admission forwards zero requests
client cancellation and stop abort upstream but hidden work keeps the drain blocked
freeze/drain serializes active requests, blocks admission, increments epoch and needs fresh grants
failed policy readback stays closed and unsupported graph widening is rejected
journal persists uncertainty, rejects a second writer and restart requires quiescence
accepted Chat corpus fixtures distinguish complete tools, partial output and synthetic DONE
multiple tool IDs are assembled independently and duplicate/invalid calls never complete
stop and lease expiry cancel midstream without a successful terminal
abrupt supervisor exit leaves a lock and durable reservation; offline recovery remains closed
OpenCode-style max_tokens/stream_options are denied by this explicitly narrower profile
transport loss before headers retains unknown work and does not retry or refund the reservation

limitations: No live 9Router, provider or harness conformance; only the synthetic authority proves fixture quiescence.
No inference credential, provider credential, caller token, raw response/error or private origin is written to this report.
Chat Completions text/tools with max_completion_tokens only. Other protocols/features need a separate tested profile.
